rationale: F5 shaded systems are defined by the understorey crop; crop-level yield evidence is practice evidence there (T4 method §2; synthesise-recipe.py rule).

WH practices do not define a crop system: the host crop's yield response (zaï sorghum, stone-bund millet) IS the practice effect, so crop_specific units re-enter all WH families' T3/T6 cells. species_specific never.

Pete 2026-10-16 (decision 4, option A): in paludiculture the crop (reed, cattail, Sphagnum, sago) IS the practice, exactly as the host crop's yield response is the practice effect in water harvesting. crop_specific units re-enter the peatland family's T3/T6 cells; species_specific never.
